alt: Hotel front-desk receptionist and guest both stare at a Philips dual-sided monitor sitting between them on the counter, neither looking at the other
story: Philips launched the world's first 'dual-sided' business monitor so two people can share a screen in a face-to-face meeting — critics immediately noted the flaw: placing a screen between two people to help them look at each other ensures neither one does.
why_funny: The device invented to improve 'face-to-face collaboration' is a screen you put between two faces so they stop looking at each other.
